items.title: Add typed authority policy discovery client contract
items.context: Extend the existing AuthorityClient/authority-contracts surface with a GET /v1/authority/policy read-only path based on the Python authority-policy.v1 contract.
items.userSees: Test output includes: "authority enforce policy discovery smoke passed" and shows contractVersion authority-policy.v1 parsed from the fake authority response.

happy.desc: A valid authority-policy.v1 response with compatibility and digests parses and returns a discovery policy object.

edge.desc: HTTP errors, timeouts, and malformed policy bodies are reported as non-success outcomes rather than discovery success.

adversarial.desc: A policy response containing receipt, receiptId, gatePassed, or accepted is rejected or flagged as overclaim and cannot be printed as success.

items.title: Expose read-only koala authority enforce policy command boundary
items.context: Add a CLI command for the future enforce namespace that only discovers policy and makes discovery-only semantics visible.
items.userSees: Running the command against a fake policy prints: "Authority policy discovery only: no receipt, no gate pass, no evidence submission."

happy.desc: The CLI command can query a fake policy endpoint and print contractVersion, requiredAuthorityMode, commandCatalogDigest, evidenceSchemaDigest, and evidencePolicy.preset.

edge.desc: Missing authority URL or unreachable server exits non-zero with a clear policy discovery error and no local evidence write.

adversarial.desc: The command does not call /v1/evidence or /v1/evidence/batch and does not expose a flag that submits production evidence.

items.title: Preserve ordinary workflow thin-client authority behavior
items.context: Update or add smoke coverage proving the new discovery command does not alter verification_evidence_add off/shadow/enforce transport behavior.
items.userSees: Existing authority evidence flow smoke prints: authority evidence flow smoke passed. Existing boundary smoke prints: ✓ authority boundary smoke passed: CLI evidence is local/shadow/thin-client, not receipt-backed L2+ authority.

happy.desc: authority-evidence-flow smoke still passes after adding policy discovery.

edge.desc: authority-boundary smoke still classifies accepted true without verified receipt as thin-client transport accepted.

adversarial.desc: Mentioning koala authority enforce in command names or policy output does not promote workflow evidence to receipt-backed L2+.

items.title: Update PD-2 docs with Milestone 1 actual command and next boundary
items.context: Record the exact command name/syntax, state that M1 consumes policy discovery only, and keep M2+ prohibitions explicit.
items.userSees: Docs say: "Milestone 1 implemented read-only policy discovery only; actor keys, jobs, provider execution, evidence submission, and receipt verification remain unimplemented."

happy.desc: authority-client-role.md names the actual M1 command syntax and the Python /v1/authority/policy contract fields consumed.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish Python server policy discovery ownership from TS CLI policy consumption.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not claim policy discovery issues receipts, signs evidence, passes gates, or proves L2+ authority.

items.title: Create Milestone 1 validation record and next-story handoff
items.context: Capture validation evidence and concise handoff for Milestone 2+ so future work does not skip actor/signing/receipt gates.
items.userSees: Story summary says: "Milestone 1 completed read-only policy discovery; no evidence submission or runner behavior was implemented."

happy.desc: Validation evidence includes build, policy discovery smoke, authority-boundary smoke, authority-client smoke, and authority-evidence-flow smoke.

edge.desc: Handoff names the next safe milestone and the remaining explicit approval gates.

adversarial.desc: The story outcome does not claim production authority, L2+ evidence, or receipt verification was implemented.
